dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: I wonder if my friends from when I was young are doing alright now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: I'm just an old-timer with too much free time on his hands. Not like before.

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: I once crossed the rainforest and the desert when I was young. I adventured all over Teyvat, saw plenty of things, and made many friends...

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: I didn't have much money then, but what I did have was vigor and courage.

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: Then... Then I happened to dig up some treasure on one of my adventures. Some people said it was a fairy's treasure, while others said it was the legacy of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata...

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: I was just a kid then who didn't know any better, so I sold it to the highest bidder.

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: Thanks to that income, I'm able to clothe and feed myself even in my old age, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your friends from when you were young?

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: I was an energetic and tireless adventurer in my youth. I may have gotten myself into my fair share of trouble, but that's also how I made friends.

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: I remember that lad Roald would lose things all over the place. I once lent him shoes, notebooks, and a mountaineering pickaxe... before he lost them all, that is.

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: And there was that chatterbox... Cyrus? Was that his name? He had a booming voice, liked to go on and on and on, but would never listen to what anyone else had to say...

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: I hear he's the branch master of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild now, and that he's got a beautiful daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: I suppose that means he's grown up a fair bit now, that's good...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: Safe travels.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: I'm just an old-timer with too much free time on his hands nowadays.

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: I once crossed the rainforest and the desert when I was young. I adventured all over Teyvat, saw plenty of things, and made many friends...

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: I didn't have much Mora then, but what I did have were vigor and courage.

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: Then... Then I happened to dig up something precious on one of my adventures. Some people said it was one of the treasures of the spirits, and some said that it must be a relic of the Dendro Archon...

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: I was just a kid then who didn't know any better, so I sold it to the highest bidder.

dialogues.speaker: Bhabha
dialogues.text: Thanks to that income, I'm able to clothe and feed myself even in my old age, hehe.
